announcement.title: 🎨 New Module: Landing Page Maker v1.0.0
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.0.0 is now available in Early Access. Build interactive campaign pages inside Foundry VTT with 17 editable templates or your own artwork.

Watch the feature showcase on YouTube
Release details and access on Patreon

  • Edit directly on the Scene with layers, groups, image framing, alignment, undo and redo.
  • Assign Actors by drag-and-drop and connect your designs to character data, mission boards, glossaries, and session records.
  • Present images and captions in Theater, or surround playable maps with a shared editable frame.
  • Save your own blocks and themes for reuse.
